# 84. Trading Update: Augusti

**Feed**: veckans-trade  
**Published**: 2026-08-31  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is the host's August trading update. He made +6.26% for the month and called that poor, blaming an almost dead Swedish small-cap market with very low turnover. He says it was a large-cap month and that he sits on record cash. His best trades were short-term moves in Bonesupport and Flat Capital, both based on tips from a friend. His worst was a stuck position in Aftec. He calls the Sivers photonics story dead and still overvalued. Few small caps look attractive to him, and he asks listeners to send special situations such as forced sellers.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ SIVE — Sivers | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Weak report, photonics hype gone, promoter influence lost, still very overvalued, little turnover.

#### Reasoning

The host says the Sivers case is dead. The report was weak again, the photonics narrative and US social-media promotion have faded, US holders are slowly selling, a US listing is uncertain, and the valuation is still stretched. He grants it could be a local bottom but won't take a long-term view.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a US listing materialises
- if concrete commercial deals with US partners are announced

> *"Sivers-caset är ju totalt dött och allt med Photonix bara rann ut i sanden."*

---

### 🟡 MSAB-B — MSAB | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Keeps his shares: new equity story, four good quarters, no need for a placing, upside seen as larger than downside.

#### Reasoning

After a positive profit warning and a strong run, the CEO sale of 700k SEK is seen as normal. There is no capital need and no AI worry, and the risk/reward is asymmetric. The host keeps his position with 100 SEK as a loose target.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the stock reaches about 100 SEK
- if a placing or weaker quarter breaks the equity story

> *"Placing känns osannolikt. Man behöver inte ta in pengar. Man har en ny equity story, man har haft fyra fina kvartal i raken. Ingen AI-oro. Så jag håller kvar mina aktier."*

---

### 🟠 PAX — Paxman | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Strong report and still looks cheap, but the host won't buy while retail piles in; tougher comparisons ahead.

#### Reasoning

He likes the report and valuation, and thinks the Jofam owners may have something planned. The stock has already run and retail is chasing it, so he is waiting rather than buying high.

#### Sell Triggers

- weak next quarter given tougher comparisons

> *"Jag tyckte Paxman hade en jättefin rapport, men den har ju stuckit som fan sedan dess."*

---

### 🟠 FLAT-B — Flat Capital | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Trading vehicle only. Klarna proxy, trades around news and the discount/premium; he closed his trade the same day.

#### Reasoning

The host sees no underlying value creation and treats Flat Capital purely as a Klarna proxy for tactical trades on news and discount swings. He is not long-term positive.

#### Sell Triggers

- trading at a premium to NAV
- fading Klarna news flow

> *"Flat Capital har ju bara blivit en proxy för oss traders att tjäna pengar på."*

---

### 🔴 BURE — Bure Equity | **SELL** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Sold into an unexplained rally; the Prio Nilsson manager also sold Bure on the rally.

#### Reasoning

He bought on a wide discount and sold when the stock jumped with no clear trigger. The cited fund manager did the same and rotated into Enity.

> *"Så jag hoppas väl att jag har sålt mina Bure."*

---

### 🔴 RUG — Rugvista | **SELL** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Sold into a media-driven jump of about 12% after Affärsvärlden repeated its buy call.

#### Reasoning

The host's rule is to sell when media hype moves a stock ('veckans aktie'), because that buying is short-term.

> *"Rögvista lyfte typ 12 procent på att affärsvärlden sa att vi återupprepar köp."*

---

### 🟢 ENITY — Enity | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Cited fund manager Martin Lindqvist added to Enity as it is cheap with forced sellers.

#### Reasoning

This is the view of the cited fund manager, not the host. He sees the niche bank as a bit too cheap with forced selling pressure, and moved capital from Bure into it.

#### Sell Triggers

- if forced selling persists and the valuation gap does not close

> *"Den här nischbanken Enity som man lite flaggade för ... Det är lite för billigt och det känns som att det är lite forcerade säljare i marknaden."*

---
